name: Taste Buds Kitchen East Greenwich – Kids Summer Cooking Camps
description_short: Indoor cooking and baking day camp for ages 4-17. Each week runs Monday to Friday with a new theme, as 3-hour morning (ages 4-8) or afternoon (ages 9-13) sessions, and kids take home food samples.
refund_policy_summary: All sales are final and non-refundable. You can reschedule yourself up to 5 days before the start time, but not within 5 days. Optional Camp Protection, bought at booking, lets you cancel for any reason up to 5 hours before the first class and get a kitchen credit for the ticket amount (minus protection and processing fees). The credit is valid for 6 months.
special_needs_notes: All menus are nut-free. Camp menus have no gluten, dairy or egg substitutions, and the kitchen is not allergy-free. Kids with allergies may bring their own nut-free portion that needs no heating or preparation.
